items.title: Kyren Williams: Limited at practice
items.text:
Williams (toe) was a limited practice participant Sunday, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.

items.title: Jared Goff: Efficient effort in win
items.text:
Goff completed 20 of 28 passes for 279 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions while adding five rushes for 12 yards in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.

items.title: Josh Johnson: Modest numbers in Week 11 start
items.text:
Johnson completed 18 of 31 passes for 155 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 34-7 loss to Kansas City. he added five yards on two carries.

items.title: Trey McBride: Big volume in loss to KC
items.text:
McBride caught nine of 14 targets for 54 yards in Sunday's 34-7 loss to Kansas City. He added four yards on his only carry.

items.title: Cam Ward: Solid numbers in Week 11 loss
items.text:
Ward completed 21 of 30 passes for 248 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions while rushing twice for three yards and another score in the Titans' 51-30 loss to the Cowboys on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.
